title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：needle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 needle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the tailor ① threaded the needle that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the threading was the whole of the week. The ② needle, meaning the pin itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a needle, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ needle in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ needle at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A needle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the tailor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the needle was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the pin. The ⑥ needle, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; needle, he said, is either something you thread or the only word that means both a pin and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ needle had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ needle of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of describing; needle, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ needle I remember is the pin described in the order, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ needle, my mother said in 1976, is the only pin that improves by being described; every needle, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like a pin. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 针（指裁缝铺里每一枚旁边的那一枚）
B. n. 针（指那枚针本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：thread the needle 穿这一枚针
D. n. 针（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 针之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的针之事）
F. n. 针（指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一枚）
G. n. 针、细致（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 细致（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: threaded the needle that no customer in the shop would have described
The needle, meaning the pin itself and not the needle
the needle at the far mirror
the needle was the whole of the matter
the needle had become a line in an order
The needle of the whole thing
A needle, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: thread the needle 意为“穿这一枚针”，1967 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一枚针做了一遍。
needle 意为“针”，指那枚针本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
needle 意为“针”，指裁缝铺里每一枚旁边的那一枚，每一枚旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
needle 意为“针”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
needle 意为“针、细致”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这枚细致就是那件事的全部。
needle 意为“细致”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那枚针，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
needle 意为“针”，指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一枚，到 1972 年这一枚成了订单簿里的一行。
needle 意为“针之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的针之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的描述。
needle 意为“针”，我记得的是订单簿里描述过的那一枚，1974 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一枚。
needle 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，针是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的针。
